name: A-COLOR US LLC
old_description: Professional high-quality custom printing for medium and small businesses.
about:
A-COLOR US LLC operates from Delaware City, Delaware. The company was founded by Daniel Vielma, who serves as General Manager and Owner, growing from a small idea into a provider of custom apparel and printing services.

The shop specializes in screen printing, embroidery, and UV coating for custom apparel, offering a three-step workflow: clients request a quote, approve a digital mock-up, and receive finished goods boxed and shipped. Orders start at a minimum of 12 pieces per design, with a standard turnaround of three to five business days and flat-rate pricing. The team also assists with artwork preparation and accommodates multiple print locations per garment.

Its customer base spans construction, landscaping, restaurant, and retail sectors, serving small and medium-sized businesses that need branded uniforms, promotional wear, or marketing materials. Testimonials highlight responsive communication and quick resolution of production issues.

Vielma started the business from a passion for creativity and a commitment to helping companies stand out, emphasizing collaboration, efficiency, and design innovation as core differentiators. The firm promotes a flat-rate pricing model to simplify budgeting for recurring orders.
